description: The Six to Ten of Swords in tarot: upright and reversed meanings for transition, strategy, feeling trapped, anxiety and endings, as prompts for reflection.
lede: The Six to Ten of Swords carry the suit of thought through transition, secrecy, feeling trapped, worry and the end of a hard stretch.

faces.alt: Five original gold-linework tarot card faces in a row, Six to Ten of Swords in order. Each shows its number and a sword icon, with the card name beneath. There are no scenes or published artwork.
faces.caption: The Swords run from a steady crossing to a final low point. Read each as a description of how thinking feels, not as a fixed outcome.
